subject: Security discovery: cloud roster + data routing questions
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@omnihealth.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security discovery: cloud roster + data routing questions

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick written recap from the call and the asks we discussed so we can keep momentum.

Call recap:
- OmniHealth is evaluating Redwood for document ingestion + in-app summarization; primary data class discussed: patient administrative + clinical metadata (PHI present in some files).
- You confirmed SOC 2 Type II will be available (in progress) and that OmniHealth is subject to HIPAA.
- Primary cloud hosts: AWS (us-west-2) for ingestion; Snowflake for analytics; a separate analytics vendor (AnalyzeNow) receives de-identified metrics.

Immediate asks / next steps (what we need from you):
1) Subprocessor roster: a one-sheet list of current cloud & third-party vendors that may touch customer data (cloud providers, analytics, monitoring, logging, BI). We attached a vendor_roster_template.xlsx you can use.
2) Routing diagram: rough data flow diagram (png or draw.io) showing where PHI is stored vs where de-identified data flows — this helps us scope encryption / tokenization controls. We left a draft routing_diagram_draft.png in Drive for reference.
3) SOC evidence cadence: ETA on SOC 2 Type II report and whether you can provide a SOC bridge letter in the interim.
4) HIPAA specifics: which data elements you consider PHI and any existing BAA terms we should be aware of.

Redwood commitments:
- We will kick off our security questionnaire (attached redwood_security_questionnaire.pdf) and send a DocuSign link for a quick intake.
- Aditya will own the questionnaire outreach; Grace will handle technical follow-ups on the routing diagram.

Proposed timeline:
- Vendor roster + routing diagram: please share by EOD Sep 6 if possible.
- We’ll send the questionnaire today; target return by Sep 10.

If anything above is off or you want to add people to the thread (security, legal), let me know and I’ll loop them in. Thanks — looking forward to closing this block so we can move to a PoC.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Evelyn.hart@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: vendor_roster_template.xlsx, routing_diagram_draft.png, redwood_security_questionnaire.pdf
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@omnihealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@omnihealth.com>
Date: 2028-09-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security discovery: cloud roster + data routing questions

Evelyn — great recap, thanks. Quick answers and I attached our current vendor roster (omni_vendor_roster.xlsx).

- SOC 2: We completed Type I last quarter; Type II testing is underway with target Q4 delivery. We can provide a SOC I/bridge letter next week.
- HIPAA: Yes, OmniHealth is HIPAA-covered. PHI examples: full name, DOB, MRN, billing codes, clinical notes. We redact direct identifiers for analytics where possible.
- Current processors that touch identifiable data: AWS (S3), EKS (us-west-2), Snowflake (analytics), and our monitoring stack (LogFlow). AnalyzeNow Inc. receives only de-identified aggregates.

I’m attaching omni_vendor_roster.xlsx — it’s a bit rough but includes cert flags (SOC2, ISO27001) where known.

We’ll work on a routing diagram and share by Sep 6 as requested. Priya (cc) is our security lead and will help with the SOC/BAA details.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of IT, OmniHealth
alex.rivera@omnihealth.com
+1 (206) 555-4422

Attachment: omni_vendor_roster.xlsx

Subject: Re: Security discovery: cloud roster + data routing questions

Alex — thanks for the fast turnaround and the roster. We’ll do the following on our side:
- I’ll send the redwood_security_questionnaire.pdf via DocuSign right after this email (link included in thread metadata). Please sign and complete the questionnaire fields; that speeds legal/security review.
- Grace will review the vendor roster for high-risk processors (logging, analytics, backups) and flag any follow-ups.
- For BAAs: can you share the current BAA template you use with cloud vendors, or point us to the clause that governs downstream processor flow? That will help us map the DPA redline scope.

Action owners and rough SLAs:
- Aditya (Redwood) — kick off questionnaire (deliverable: completed doc) — target Sep 10.
- Grace (Redwood) — vendor triage & questions — target Sep 12.
- Alex / Priya (OmniHealth) — routing diagram + BAA/template — target Sep 6.

If those targets look off, flag and we’ll adapt. Thanks.

-Aditya

aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-09-05T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security discovery: cloud roster + data routing questions — next steps

Thanks everyone — short status note and single-sheet action plan so we have clear owners.

Status:
- Omni supplied omni_vendor_roster.xlsx (thanks Alex).
- You indicated HIPAA coverage and ongoing SOC 2 Type II work.

Single-sheet action plan (owners / due dates):
1) Omni: routing diagram (show PHI at-rest locations + de-id flows) — owner: Priya Shah — due: 2028-09-06 EOD.
2) Redwood: security questionnaire (DocuSign) — owner: Aditya Rao — sent today; request return by 2028-09-10.
3) Redwood: vendor triage and risk notes (focus: logging/backup processors, analytics) — owner: Grace O'Connor — due: 2028-09-12.
4) Omni / Redwood: BAA/DPA touchpoints — owner: Priya & Marissa Cole (Redwood legal lead) — initial redline exchange by 2028-09-14.

Risks / discussion points flagged during triage we may follow up on:
- LogFlow (monitoring): confirm whether logs contain PHI and whether they are retained outside redaction windows.
- Snowflake: confirm whether copies of raw ingest are retained in dev/non-prod environments.
- AnalyzeNow: confirm contractual guarantees around de-identification and re-identification risk.

Deliverables attached to thread: vendor_roster_template.xlsx (our template), redwood_security_questionnaire.pdf (intake), omni_vendor_roster.xlsx (your roster). We’ll drop the routing diagram into the Drive link in related_links when ready.

If you’re happy with the plan I’ll convert this into a one-pager and share with your security team. Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’ll aim to keep the security touchpoints tight so we can start a limited PoC once questionnaire + routing diagram are validated.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
